before.name: Developer Console - Display discrepancy on the Installations Page
updates: We have identified the cause of the issue affecting the Developer Console where app versions and statuses in the Installation tab appear outdated. Please note that app installations and auto-upgrades continue to function normally in the background; this is isolated to the display in the Developer Console. We are actively deploying a fix to correct the display. We will provide the next update in 1 - hour or sooner.

after.name: Developer Console - Display discrepancy on the Installations Page
updates: On September 17, 2026, some Developer Console users may have experienced performance degradation where versions and statuses in the Installation tab were outdated. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

The fix to correct the display discrepancy in the Developer Console Installation tab remains underway. Core app installations and upgrades are unaffected. We will provide the next update in 2 hours, or sooner.
